key_insight: The paper shows that exact ensemble controllability of neural differential equations can be achieved constructively by solving a neural interpolation problem, and for depth-2 networks this reduces to a linear system.
engineering_relevance: This gives a principled way to train one neural dynamics to steer multiple initial conditions to different targets simultaneously, which is useful for multi-task control and learning systems.
method: Formulate exact ensemble controllability for neural differential equations.
Reduce the control design to a neural interpolation problem.
For depth-2 right-hand sides, convert interpolation into linear equations and solve constructively.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical constructive result and a reduction to linear equations for depth-2 networks, rather than an empirical benchmark.
watch_item: The approach is mathematically exact under the stated model assumptions, so practical use may depend on whether real systems fit the neural dynamics and interpolation conditions.
paper_title: Exact ensemble controllability for neural differential equations via neural interpolation
